article.title: Can less competition mean more meritocracy?
article.excerpt: I am not so sure, but Dawei Fang and Thomas Noe say yes: Uncompetitive contests for grades, promotions, and job assignments, which feature lax standards or consider only limited talent pools, are often criticized for being unmeritocratic.
